r1c_reference_anchor.rationale: Its design-led compositional prior can encourage solved hierarchy and art-directed balance, but the same anchor produced a more credible rice-granary sample. The unisolated factor is interaction with tofu/workshop subject prior.

tofu_traditional_workshop_subject_prior.rationale: Repeated failures concentrate on canonical generative motifs of heritage craft imagery: uniformly attractive aged wood, wet sheen, draped cloth, complete readable apparatus, tidy process storytelling and overly regular curd texture. Same renderer plus same R1C performed better on rice granary.

shared_base_prompt_structure.rationale: The first 9:16 base was checklist-heavy, but the P4 low-load single-moment repair removed the major checklist structure and the absolute failures persisted.

compact_six_controls.rationale: Route A omitted all six while Route B retained them, yet both failed all absolute realism gates. The controls may increase visual solvedness/density in B, but cannot explain Route A failure.

chatgpt_images_mode_prior.rationale: The evidence does not support a universal renderer failure because rice granary was more credible. It supports a renderer prior that becomes especially stereotyped on traditional tofu/workshop imagery, amplified by design-led reference conditioning.

root_cause_model.mechanism: The renderer appears to satisfy 'traditional tofu workshop' by synthesizing a coherent heritage-workshop visual schema, then the R1C design-led reference and VPD composition goals reward legibility, hierarchy and balance. The result is semantically correct but causally over-designed: objects are arranged to explain the scene rather than arising from one messy production event.

frozen_minimal_next_strategy.purpose: Isolate whether R1C reference conditioning is a necessary amplifier before changing renderer, subject, or adding any realism rules.
